profile.address: 1000 San Leandro Blvd., Suite 300, San Leandro, CA 94577
profile.summary: The Alameda County Public Health Department is a county government agency within Alameda County Health. It works with local communities on population-level health and on preventing the root causes of health inequity. Its programs include school-based dental and behavioral health services and immunization requirements for schools and childcare facilities.

review.notes: Identity is sound (the county department named in the agenda; address, phone, parent agency and orgType confirmed on health.alamedacountyca.gov). However, the summary attributes school-based behavioral health to the Public Health Department when the source places it under the separate Behavioral Health Department, and the 'population-level health / root causes of health inequity' wording was not confirmed (the page states a partnership mission only), so the summary is not fully supported.
